Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Dull olive-green to brown velvety spots on upper leaf surfaces and fruit lesions.

treatment.organic: Apply sulfur or lime sulfur sprays early in the season; prune canopy to increase sunlight penetration.
treatment.chemical: Spray Captan 50% WP @ 2.5g/L or Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5ml/L.

Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Rake and compost fallen leaves in autumn, apply urea to accelerate leaf breakdown, and select resistant cultivars.

Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Small purple specks on leaves expanding into circular 'frog-eye' lesions with dark margins and tan centers.

treatment.organic: Prune out mummified fruit, dead twigs, and cankers. Apply copper fungicides during dormancy.
treatment.chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Thiophanate-methyl 70% WP @ 1g/L.

Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Keep trees vigorous through balanced fertilization, prevent insect wounding, and remove dead wood.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.symptoms: Bright yellow-orange circular spots on upper leaf surfaces; tube-like aecia structures beneath leaves.

treatment.organic: Remove nearby eastern red cedar trees if practical; apply sulfur or biofungicides at bud-break.
treatment.chemical: Foliar spray with Myclobutanil @ 1ml/L or Mancozeb @ 2g/L from pink bud to petal fall.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Eradicate galls on alternate juniper hosts within 1-2 miles, and plant rust-resistant apple varieties.

Apple___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant green, uniform leaf lamina without chlorosis, spots, or abnormal curling.

treatment.organic: Maintain organic mulching and microbial soil amendments.
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Apple___healthy.prevention: Continue standard seasonal pruning, balanced fertilization, and pest scouting.

Blueberry___healthy.symptoms: Dark green, waxy leaves with no necrotic lesions or leaf curling.

treatment.organic: Apply pine bark mulch to preserve soil acidity (pH 4.5 - 5.5).
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Maintain acidic soil conditions and avoid overhead irrigation.

Cherry___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: White powdery fungal patches on young leaves, resulting in puckering, upward curling, and shoot distortion.

treatment.organic: Spray potassium bicarbonate (3g/L) or neem oil (0.5%) at first sight of mycelium.
treatment.chemical: Spray Hexaconazole 5% SC @ 1ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1ml/L.

Cherry___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Prune dense canopies to maximize air circulation and avoid excessive late-season nitrogen.

Cherry___healthy.symptoms: Uniform deep green foliage free of fungal powdery coatings or shot-hole lesions.

treatment.organic: Maintain regular organic compost and mulching.
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Cherry___healthy.prevention: Monitor orchards regularly for aphids, mites, and leaf spot signs.

Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_sp.hindi_name: मक्के का ग्रे लीफ स्पॉट रोग
Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_sp.symptoms: Rectangular, tan to gray necrotic lesions bordered by leaf veins, coalescing to blighted leaves.

treatment.organic: Incorporate Trichoderma harzianum soil amendments; rotate crops with soybeans or legumes.
treatment.chemical: Spray Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 1g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1ml/L at tasseling.

Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_sp.prevention: Utilize resistant hybrid varieties, practice 2-year crop rotation, and deep plow infected residue.

Corn___Common_rust.symptoms: Golden-brown to cinnamon-brown powdery pustules erupted on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.

treatment.organic: Apply wettable sulfur (80% WP) @ 2g/L or biological bio-fungicide Bacillus subtilis.
treatment.chemical: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L or Difenoconazole @ 0.5ml/L.

Corn___Common_rust.prevention: Plant resistant hybrids and plant early in the season to escape peak spore dispersal.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Long, elliptical cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions (2.5 to 15 cm long) spreading across leaf blades.

treatment.organic: Foliar bio-formulations with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5g/L.
treatment.chemical: Foliar application of Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 1ml/L.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Choose corn varieties with single-gene (Ht) or polygenic resistance; bury crop debris post-harvest.

Corn___healthy.symptoms: Broad, vibrant green leaves with intact veins and no rust pustules or necrotic streaks.

treatment.organic: Ensure adequate nitrogen side-dressing and organic manure during knee-high stage.
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Corn___healthy.prevention: Follow optimal seed drill spacing and maintain weed-free crop rows.

Grape___Black_rot.symptoms: Small circular reddish-brown leaf spots with tiny black fruiting bodies (pycnidia) in rings; shriveled black berries.

treatment.organic: Copper-based fungicides like Bordeaux mixture (1%) before rain events; prune infected shoots.
treatment.chemical: Spray Mancozeb @ 2.5g/L or Myclobutanil 10% WP @ 1g/L starting at budbreak.

Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Remove mummified berries from trellises during winter pruning and maintain open vine canopy.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).symptoms: 'Tiger-stripe' interveinal chlorosis and necrosis on leaves; dark spots on berries with trunk wood rot.

treatment.organic: Prune affected cordons down to healthy wood; apply wound sealants containing Trichoderma.
treatment.chemical: Protect pruning wounds with pyraclostrobin or paint with fungicide paste.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Disinfect pruning shears between vines and avoid large cutting wounds during wet weather.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.symptoms: Irregular dark brown to black spots with distinct borders on leaves, causing premature defoliation.

treatment.organic: Spray copper oxychloride @ 2.5g/L or certified organic sulfur formulations.
treatment.chemical: Spray Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Improve trellis canopy aeration and spray prophylactically after seasonal monsoon showers.

Grape___healthy.symptoms: Clean green palmate leaves with sharp margins and no discolorations or mildew spots.

treatment.organic: Support with balanced potassium and organic compost application.
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Grape___healthy.prevention: Perform regular summer shoot positioning and sucker removal.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).cause: Bacterial (Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticus) vectored by Asian citrus psyllid
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).symptoms: Asymmetric blotchy mottled chlorosis across leaf veins; small lopsided bitter fruits that stay green.

treatment.organic: Control psyllid insect vectors using neem seed kernel extract (5%) or yellow sticky traps.
treatment.chemical: Foliar nutrition with zinc, iron, and manganese; control vectors with Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5ml/L.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Use certified disease-free nursery saplings; eradicate severely infected declined trees immediately.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small angular water-soaked purple-black spots that drop out, creating a 'shot-hole' appearance.

treatment.organic: Apply copper hydroxide spray @ 2g/L during dormancy and petal fall.
treatment.chemical: Spray Streptocycline @ 0.2g/L + Copper Oxychloride @ 2g/L.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Avoid planting susceptible cultivars in wind-exposed, sandy sites; plant windbreaks.

Peach___healthy.symptoms: Glossy green, lanceolate leaves without shot holes, curling, or bacterial spots.

treatment.organic: Apply organic mulch around the tree drip line.
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Peach___healthy.prevention: Annual pruning during dormancy and routine monitoring for borer pests.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.hindi_name: शिमला मिर्च का जीवाणु धब्बा रोग
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, circular to irregular water-soaked spots turning dark brown with yellow halos; defoliation.

treatment.organic: Spray copper-based bactericides combined with bio-formulations like Bacillus subtilis.
treatment.chemical: Foliar spray with Copper Hydroxide @ 2g/L combined with Streptomycin sulfate @ 0.2g/L.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified disease-free treated seeds, drip irrigation, and avoid handling plants when foliage is wet.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.symptoms: Uniform deep green foliage without blistering, water-soaked spots, or mosaic patterns.

treatment.organic: Regular vermicompost applications and calcium-rich eggshell/lime amendments.
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.prevention: Maintain consistent soil moisture to prevent blossom end rot and leaf stress.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Brown circular spots with target-like rings on lower leaves, leading to leaf blighting and reduced tuber yield.

treatment.organic: Bio-fungicides like Trichoderma viride foliar spray @ 5g/L.
treatment.chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L or Propineb 70% WP @ 2g/L upon first symptom appearance.

Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed tubers, avoid drought stress during bulking, and rotate with non-host crops like legumes.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Dark brown water-soaked lesions with pale green borders; white fuzzy sporulation on underside during damp weather.

treatment.organic: Destroy infected haulms immediately; apply prophylactic sprays of Bordeaux mixture (1%).
treatment.chemical: Foliar spray with Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2g/L or Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1g/L.

Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified disease-free seed tubers, avoid overhead irrigation, and earth-up properly to protect tubers.

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Clean, green foliage without spots or wilting.

treatment.organic: Maintain balanced organic fertilization and hilling-up practices.
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Potato___healthy.prevention: Ensure good drainage and rotate with cereals or pulses.

Raspberry___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant green compound leaves without mosaic mottle or rust pustules.

treatment.organic: Apply composted woodchip mulch to maintain root moisture.
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Raspberry___healthy.prevention: Prune spent floricanes after fruiting and provide sturdy trellis support.

Soybean___healthy.symptoms: Healthy trifoliate leaves, uniform dark green color, absence of frogeye or bacterial blight lesions.

treatment.organic: Inoculate seeds with Rhizobium japonicum biofertilizer for biological nitrogen fixation.
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Soybean___healthy.prevention: Rotate crops with corn or wheat and maintain optimal seed spacing.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: Talcing white talcum-powder-like fungal patches on leaf surfaces and petioles; leaves yellow and dry prematurely.

treatment.organic: Spray milk-water solution (40:60 ratio) in sunlight or potassium bicarbonate @ 3g/L.
treatment.chemical: Spray Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5ml/L or Dinocap @ 1ml/L.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Choose resistant squash varieties, space vines adequately for sun and airflow, and avoid late afternoon watering.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.symptoms: Numerous small, dark purple spots on upper leaf surfaces that expand and merge, giving the entire leaf a scorched, brown appearance.

treatment.organic: Remove and destroy dried, scorched foliage; spray bio-formulated Trichoderma @ 5g/L.
treatment.chemical: Spray Captan 50% WP @ 2.5g/L or Thiophanate-methyl @ 1g/L.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Renew strawberry beds regularly, use plastic mulch to prevent soil-splash, and avoid overhead sprinkler watering.

Strawberry___healthy.symptoms: Dark green, glossy trifoliate leaves with serrated margins and no purplish spots.

treatment.organic: Ensure adequate pine-needle or straw mulching around the crowns.
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Maintain drip irrigation and scout weekly for spider mites.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, dark, greasy or water-soaked spots with yellow halos on leaves; scabby dark lesions on green fruit.

treatment.organic: Copper soap sprays combined with bio-fungicide Bacillus amyloliquefaciens.
treatment.chemical: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.2g/L.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use hot water-treated seed, practice a 2-year rotation away from solanaceous crops, and sterilize stakes.

Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown to black spots with concentric rings (target board pattern) primarily on older leaves. Lower leaves yellow and drop prematurely.

treatment.organic: Apply neem oil (0.5%) spray or copper hydroxide spray. Remove and burn heavily infected lower foliage.
treatment.chemical: Foliar spray with Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L or Chlorothalonil @ 2g/L every 7-10 days.

Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Practice crop rotation (avoid solanaceous crops for 2 years), maintain proper plant spacing for air circulation, and use drip irrigation to keep foliage dry.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked, dark greasy lesions on leaves and stems; white moldy growth visible under leaves during high humidity.

treatment.organic: Immediate removal of affected plants. Apply preventive sprays of Bordeaux mixture (1%).
treatment.chemical: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil MZ) @ 2.5g/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2g/L.

Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Ensure good drainage, destroy volunteer tomato and potato plants, and avoid overhead sprinkler watering.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale green or yellowish spots on upper leaf surfaces; velvety olive-brown mold growth beneath the leaf.

treatment.organic: Lower greenhouse humidity below 85% by venting; apply bio-fungicide Bacillus pumilus.
treatment.chemical: Spray Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L or Difenoconazole @ 0.5ml/L.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Provide adequate air circulation through greenhouse fans and maintain warm temperatures.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Numerous small circular spots with grayish-white centers and dark brown borders, dotted with black pycnidia specks.

treatment.organic: Prune out infected lower leaves; apply liquid copper octanoate bio-fungicide.
treatment.chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Mulch soil around plants to prevent spores from splashing up from the soil; clean tools with bleach solution.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.symptoms: Fine yellow or white stippling on upper leaf surfaces; fine silk webbing on undersides; leaves bronze and desiccate.

treatment.organic: Release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis) or spray insecticidal soap / neem oil (1%).
treatment.chemical: Spray Propargite 57% EC @ 2ml/L or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1ml/L.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Avoid dusty conditions, keep plants adequately irrigated, and avoid overuse of broad-spectrum pyrethroid insecticides.

Tomato___Target_Spot.hindi_name: टमाटर का लक्ष्य धब्बा रोग (टारगेट स्पॉट)
Tomato___Target_Spot.symptoms: Brown circular lesions with faint concentric rings; lesions cause leaf yellowing and blighting.

treatment.organic: Apply biological Trichoderma viride foliar spray or copper hydroxide.
treatment.chemical: Spray Famoxadone + Cymoxanil @ 1.5g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1ml/L.

Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Ensure good spacing between plants, avoid handling wet plants, and manage greenhouse relative humidity.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.hindi_name: टमाटर का पीला पत्ती मरोड़ विषाणु (पत्ती कर्ल)
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.symptoms: Severe stunting of plants, upward cupping of leaves, yellowing (chlorosis) of leaf margins, reduced fruit set.

treatment.organic: Install yellow sticky traps (15-20 traps/acre); spray neem oil (1%) to repel whiteflies.
treatment.chemical: Vector control using Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.5g/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Use insect-proof netting in nurseries, rogue out infected plants immediately, and select TYLCV-resistant hybrids.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottled alternating light and dark green areas on leaves, distortion ('shoestring' appearance), internal fruit browning.

treatment.organic: No cure exists once infected; rogue and burn infected plants immediately; dip hands/tools in 20% nonfat milk solution.
treatment.chemical: No chemical control for viral diseases. Focus on sanitation and hygiene.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Use certified virus-free seed, do not smoke or handle tobacco near tomato plants, and disinfect shears with bleach.

Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Leaf tissue is vibrant green, uniform, without chlorosis, spots, or abnormal curling.

treatment.organic: Maintain regular organic compost and mulching to sustain soil biology.
treatment.chemical: No chemical intervention needed.

Tomato___healthy.prevention: Continue balanced NPK fertigation, regular scouting for pests (whiteflies/aphids), and adequate watering.
